purpose: Causal initial reserve only, no new training and no change to network weights or capacity
selection: validation overloaded slots, excess requests, total cost including preparation estimate
test_note: Previously observed test, repeated diagnostic evaluation
preparation_note: Decision uses only requests before t=start-6. Replay six real pre-start intervals, expanding at most one shard per step; charge actual simulated server, overload and accumulated repeated migration costs. Publish pre-start overload separately; zero post-start does not mean zero during warmup.
